description: Exact J-lens and J-space analysis of the trained PicoGPT specimen.

sampling.reduction: Steering covers all 80 edited positions; later steering readouts use window 1 to meet the 3 MiB budget. Ablations and swaps retain all later positions.

conventions.jacobian: J[output coordinate,input coordinate,depth] = mean over windows and sources of SUM over causal targets K; (T+1)/2 times the literal uniform-pair average; averaged=self+future
conventions.ids: 1-based; 0 only pads subsets and out-of-window readout ids
conventions.interventions: readout ids index probability_table[:,id]; steer axes [column,character,alpha]; steer_later_window1 axes [offset,position,character,alpha]; ablate [offset,column,character]; swap [offset,column,pair]; offset=1 is edited position; 0 pads beyond window
conventions.j_space: selected[slot,k,column]; coefficients match selected, zero-padded after slot k
conventions.lens: softmax(Wout LN(Jx;gamma_f,beta_f)+bout), epsilon=1e-5; J_L=I gives the exact model readout
conventions.literal_lens: lenses.literal uses J/((T+1)/2), the uniform causal-pair average, with the same fixed epsilon=1e-5
conventions.blocks: [output coordinate,input coordinate,target,source,depth] = ((T+1)/2)*K; window 1; divide by jacobian_factor for the raw derivative; anti-causal zeros are padding
